## What I Do

Julianna Head partners with businesses across wellness, hospitality, professional services, consumer/DTC brands, and growth-stage companies. She identifies where revenue leaks out of funnels and operations, then architects end-to-end systems — design, build, market, measure, improve — under one roof.

- Web & app development, software consulting
